game_concept: A full-screen welcome cinematic introduces LogiCade and its learning journey.
theme: The Kingdom – Moat Bridge: the drawbridge over the moat
core_gameplay_loop: Watch the full-screen LogiCade prologue; completion unlocks the flowchart stage.
player_objective: Watch the LogiCade prologue to completion before entering the first learning challenge.
controls: Full-screen video; no pause or skip controls. Click only if sound autoplay is blocked.
win_condition: The prologue video reaches its end.
lose_condition: The video is closed before completion.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Copy Cat' (Week 1 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Moat Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: The video has no skip or pause controls.
When it ends, continue to Stage 2.
